title: Accident Detection
oneLiner: Dashcam accident-detection PoC running real-time on an NVIDIA Jetson with cloud alerting.
objective: Simulate an intelligent dashcam streaming endpoint that detects accidents in real time for timely acknowledgment.
achievements: Built an accident-detection PoC for dashcams using a pretrained MoViNet CNN.
Deployed the model on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano for real-time, on-device inference.
Integrated cloud-based alerting to raise flags the moment an accident is detected.
